settings.heading: Twelve letters.
settings.text: One for each stretch of the season. Read one when you need it, answer it when you can, and skip the ones that aren't for today.

settings.heading: A page to breathe.
settings.text: Halfway through, a quiet page that asks nothing of you. You can come back to it as often as you need.

settings.heading: A page to keep.
settings.text: A "to read aloud" page and a "kept here" page for the words and moments you want to hold onto.

settings.heading: Open in Canva, make it yours.
settings.text: After you buy, you'll get a link to your own copy of the 20-page template in Canva. Change the wording, fonts and colors, add your own photos, then print it at home or at a print shop, or download it as a PDF. Start with the cover and the "belongs to" page, then take the letters at your own pace.

settings.heading: The details.
settings.text: 20 pages. US Letter. Delivered as a Canva template link, nothing ships. A free Canva account is all you need to edit it.

settings.heading: A gentle note.
settings.text: This is a companion for hard seasons, not a replacement for care from a doctor or counselor. If you're struggling, please reach out to someone who can sit with you.

settings.heading: Using it.
settings.text: For your own use and for gifts you make from it. Please don't resell, share or redistribute the template itself.
